name: Alcovia GTM tracker
description: P2 · sample data, made up for illustration. Every card is a KPI file from sql/kpis/p2_gtm_tracker.

cards.name: 01 · Revenue collected
cards.sql:
-- KPI 1: Revenue collected
-- Definition : All payments received in the period, across the three streams.
-- Formula    : SUM(payment amount) where payment date in period
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : ₹15,00,000 × months in period
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue_collected, COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM revenue.payments, p
WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 02 · Revenue vs target %
cards.sql:
-- KPI 2: Revenue vs target %
-- Definition : Revenue collected as a share of the period's target.
-- Formula    : Revenue ÷ (monthly revenue target × months in period)
-- Source     : Razorpay + targets
-- Target     : 100% or more
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(amount)                                 AS revenue,
       round(ads.target('revenue_month') * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e))                                AS target,
       round(100 * SUM(amount) / (ads.target('revenue_month') * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e)))          AS pct_of_target
FROM revenue.payments, p
WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY p.s, p.e

cards.name: 03 · Revenue change vs before
cards.sql:
-- KPI 3: Revenue change vs before
-- Definition : How revenue moved against the same-length period just before.
-- Formula    : (Revenue this period − revenue period before) ÷ revenue period before
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : Above 0%
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
cur  AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM revenue.payments, p WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e),
prev AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM revenue.payments, p WHERE paid_on BETWEEN ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e) AND p.s - 1)
SELECT cur.revenue AS this_period, prev.revenue AS period_before,
       round(100 * (cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0)) AS change_pct
FROM cur, prev

cards.name: 12 · Conversions
cards.sql:
-- KPI 12: Conversions
-- Definition : Families who paid for the full term in the period: the full program, or a trial renewal.
-- Formula    : COUNT(Full program payments) + COUNT(Trial renewal payments) in period
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : 4 per month
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type IN ('Full program', 'Trial renewal'))                          AS this_period,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type = 'Trial renewal')                AS of_which_via_trial,
       round(ads.target('full_month') * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e))                                           AS target,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type IN ('Full program', 'Trial renewal'))
     - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e) AND p.s - 1 AND payment_type IN ('Full program', 'Trial renewal')) AS change_vs_before
FROM revenue.payments, p
GROUP BY p.s, p.e

cards.name: 13 · Trials started
cards.sql:
-- KPI 13: Trials started
-- Definition : Families who paid for a 3-month trial in the period. They are in the Trial state, not converted.
-- Formula    : COUNT(Trial payments) in period
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : 6 per month
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type IN ('Trial'))                          AS this_period,
       round(ads.target('trial_month') * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e))                                           AS target,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type IN ('Trial'))
     - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e) AND p.s - 1 AND payment_type IN ('Trial')) AS change_vs_before
FROM revenue.payments, p
GROUP BY p.s, p.e

cards.name: 14 · Workshop seats sold
cards.sql:
-- KPI 14: Workshop seats sold
-- Definition : Seats paid for in the period.
-- Formula    : COUNT(Workshop seat payments) in period
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : 60 per month (30 × 2 workshops)
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type IN ('Workshop seat'))                          AS this_period,
       round(ads.target('seats_month') * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e))                                           AS target,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND payment_type IN ('Workshop seat'))
     - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_on BETWEEN ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e) AND p.s - 1 AND payment_type IN ('Workshop seat')) AS change_vs_before
FROM revenue.payments, p
GROUP BY p.s, p.e

cards.name: 18 · Workshop → program rate
cards.sql:
-- KPI 18: Workshop → program rate
-- Definition : Share of workshop attendees in the period who later converted.
-- Formula    : Workshop attendees who converted ÷ workshop attendees in period
-- Source     : Workshop attendance + ClickUp + enrolments
-- Target     : Past result about 1 in 18 (5.6%)
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(*)                                               AS workshop_attendees,
       COUNT(converted_on)                                    AS converted,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(converted_on) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS workshop_to_program_pct
FROM leads.v_lead_state, p
WHERE entry_path = 'Workshop' AND created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 20 · Days to decide
cards.sql:
-- KPI 20: Days to decide
-- Definition : Average time from first contact to first payment (trial or full).
-- Formula    : AVERAGE(first payment date − lead created date) for families who paid in the period
-- Source     : ClickUp + enrolments
-- Target     : 45 days or fewer
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT round(AVG(first_paid_on - created_on)) AS days_to_decide,
       COUNT(*)                               AS families_paid,
       ops.setting('days_to_decide')          AS target_days
FROM leads.v_lead_state, p
WHERE first_paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 07 · Stream vs target %
cards.sql:
-- KPI 7: Stream vs target %
-- Definition : Each stream's revenue against its own target.
-- Formula    : Stream revenue ÷ (stream monthly volume target × price × months in period)
-- Source     : Razorpay + targets
-- Target     : 100% or more
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
streams(stream, monthly_target) AS (VALUES
    ('Full program', ads.target('full_month')  * ads.target('full_price')),
    ('Trial',        ads.target('trial_month') * ads.target('trial_price')),
    ('Workshops',    ads.target('seats_month') * ads.target('seat_price'))),
rev AS (SELECT stream, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM revenue.v_payment_stream, p WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY stream)
SELECT st.stream, COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) AS revenue,
       round(st.monthly_target * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e)) AS target,
       round(100 * COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) / (st.monthly_target * ops.months_of_target(p.s, p.e))) AS pct_of_target
FROM streams st CROSS JOIN p LEFT JOIN rev USING (stream)
ORDER BY st.stream

cards.name: 15 · Students onboarded (by month)
cards.sql:
-- KPI 15: Students onboarded (by month)
-- Definition : New paying students each month, split full program and trial.
-- Formula    : COUNT(Full program payments) + COUNT(Trial payments) per month
-- Source     : Razorpay + ClickUp
-- Target     : 10 per month
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', paid_on), 'YYYY-MM')                       AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'Full program')                  AS full_program,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'Trial')                         AS trial,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type IN ('Full program', 'Trial'))      AS onboarded,
       round((ads.target('full_month') + ads.target('trial_month')) * ops.months_of_target(
           GREATEST(date_trunc('month', paid_on)::date, p.s),
           LEAST((date_trunc('month', paid_on) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date, p.e)), 1) AS target
FROM revenue.payments, p
WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', paid_on), p.s, p.e
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: 29 · Cost per qualified lead
cards.sql:
-- KPI 29: Cost per qualified lead
-- Definition : Program ad spend per qualified lead, with the period before.
-- Formula    : Program ad spend in period ÷ paid-ad leads qualified in period
-- Source     : Meta Ads + ClickUp
-- Target     : ₹5,000 or less
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
win(name, s, e) AS (SELECT 'This period', p.s, p.e FROM p UNION ALL SELECT 'Period before', ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e), p.s - 1 FROM p),
spend AS (SELECT win.name, SUM(d.spend) AS program_spend
          FROM win JOIN ads.ad_daily d ON d.day BETWEEN win.s AND win.e
          JOIN ads.ads a USING (ad_id) JOIN ads.campaigns c USING (campaign_id)
          WHERE c.campaign_type = 'Program' GROUP BY win.name),
qual AS (SELECT win.name, COUNT(l.lead_id) AS qualified_leads
         FROM win LEFT JOIN leads.leads l ON l.source = 'Paid' AND l.qualified_on BETWEEN win.s AND win.e GROUP BY win.name)
SELECT name, program_spend, qualified_leads,
       round(program_spend / NULLIF(qualified_leads, 0)) AS cost_per_qualified_lead,
       ads.target('cpql') AS ceiling
FROM spend JOIN qual USING (name) ORDER BY name DESC

cards.name: 10 · Unpaid invoices (amount, count)
cards.sql:
-- KPI 10: Unpaid invoices (amount, count)
-- Definition : Invoices issued and not yet paid today. Not period-based.
-- Formula    : SUM / COUNT of invoices where issued ≤ today and paid date is empty
-- Source     : Razorpay invoices
-- Target     : 0
-- Access     : full_access

SELECT COUNT(*)                                                                   AS unpaid_invoices,
       SUM(amount)                                                                AS unpaid_amount,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ops.as_of() - issued_on >= ops.setting('invoice_red')) AS unpaid_10_days_or_more
FROM revenue.invoices
WHERE paid_on IS NULL AND issued_on <= ops.as_of()

cards.name: 04 · Full program revenue
cards.sql:
-- KPI 4: Full program revenue
-- Definition : Money from the full program, including trials that renewed into it.
-- Formula    : SUM(amount) of payments in the 'Full program' stream
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : 4 × ₹2,40,000 per month
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue,
       SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'Trial renewal') AS of_which_trial_renewals,
       COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM revenue.v_payment_stream, p
WHERE stream = 'Full program' AND paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 05 · Trial revenue
cards.sql:
-- KPI 5: Trial revenue
-- Definition : Money from 3-month trials.
-- Formula    : SUM(amount) of payments in the 'Trial' stream
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : 6 × ₹50,000 per month
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue,
       SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'Trial renewal') AS of_which_trial_renewals,
       COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM revenue.v_payment_stream, p
WHERE stream = 'Trial' AND paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 06 · Workshop revenue
cards.sql:
-- KPI 6: Workshop revenue
-- Definition : Money from workshop seats.
-- Formula    : SUM(amount) of payments in the 'Workshops' stream
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : 60 × ₹3,999 per month
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue,
       SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'Trial renewal') AS of_which_trial_renewals,
       COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM revenue.v_payment_stream, p
WHERE stream = 'Workshops' AND paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 08 · Stream share of revenue
cards.sql:
-- KPI 8: Stream share of revenue
-- Definition : How much of all revenue each stream brought.
-- Formula    : Stream revenue ÷ revenue collected
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT stream, SUM(amount) AS revenue,
       round(100 * SUM(amount) / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER ()) AS share_pct
FROM revenue.v_payment_stream, p
WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY stream ORDER BY stream

cards.name: 09 · Workshop share of revenue
cards.sql:
-- KPI 9: Workshop share of revenue
-- Definition : Workshop revenue as a share of all revenue.
-- Formula    : Workshop revenue ÷ revenue collected
-- Source     : Razorpay
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE stream = 'Workshops') AS workshop_revenue,
       SUM(amount)                                     AS all_revenue,
       round(100 * SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE stream = 'Workshops') / SUM(amount)) AS workshop_share_pct
FROM revenue.v_payment_stream, p
WHERE paid_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 16 · Trial-to-full renewal rate
cards.sql:
-- KPI 16: Trial-to-full renewal rate
-- Definition : Share of trials that ended in the period and renewed into the full program.
-- Formula    : Trials renewed ÷ trials that ended in period
-- Source     : students.enrolments
-- Target     : Proposal: 50%+
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(*)                                   AS trials_ended,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Renewed') AS renewed,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Renewed') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS renewal_rate_pct
FROM students.enrolments, p
WHERE plan = 'Trial' AND status <> 'In trial' AND ends_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 40 · Workshop break-even
cards.sql:
-- KPI 40: Workshop break-even
-- Definition : Whether a workshop paid for its ads and venue.
-- Formula    : Seat revenue ÷ (workshop ad spend + venue cost)
-- Source     : Razorpay + Meta Ads + venue cost
-- Target     : 1.00 or more
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
w AS (SELECT ev.*, LAG(held_on) OVER (ORDER BY held_on) AS previous_on
      FROM events.events ev JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id) WHERE t.name = 'Public workshop'),
spend AS (SELECT w.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(d.spend), 0) AS ad_spend
          FROM w LEFT JOIN (ads.ad_daily d JOIN ads.ads a USING (ad_id) JOIN ads.campaigns c USING (campaign_id))
            ON c.campaign_type = 'Workshop' AND d.day > COALESCE(w.previous_on, '-infinity') AND d.day <= w.held_on
          GROUP BY w.event_id)
SELECT w.event_id AS workshop_id, w.held_on, w.held_on > ops.as_of() AS still_selling,
       w.seats_sold * ads.target('seat_price')                                                   AS seat_revenue,
       spend.ad_spend, ads.target('venue')                                                       AS venue_cost,
       round(w.seats_sold * ads.target('seat_price') / (spend.ad_spend + ads.target('venue')), 2) AS break_even,
       (SELECT COUNT(converted_on) FROM leads.v_lead_state l WHERE l.workshop_id = w.event_id)   AS converted_later
FROM w JOIN spend USING (event_id) CROSS JOIN p
WHERE w.held_on BETWEEN p.s AND (date_trunc('month', p.e) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date
ORDER BY w.held_on

cards.name: 39 · Ad spend per workshop seat
cards.sql:
-- KPI 39: Ad spend per workshop seat
-- Definition : Workshop ad spend per seat sold, per workshop in the period.
-- Formula    : Workshop ad spend since the previous workshop ÷ seats sold
-- Source     : Meta Ads + Razorpay
-- Target     : ₹800 or less
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
w AS (SELECT ev.*, LAG(held_on) OVER (ORDER BY held_on) AS previous_on
      FROM events.events ev JOIN events.event_types t USING (event_type_id) WHERE t.name = 'Public workshop'),
spend AS (SELECT w.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(d.spend), 0) AS ad_spend
          FROM w LEFT JOIN (ads.ad_daily d JOIN ads.ads a USING (ad_id) JOIN ads.campaigns c USING (campaign_id))
            ON c.campaign_type = 'Workshop' AND d.day > COALESCE(w.previous_on, '-infinity') AND d.day <= w.held_on
          GROUP BY w.event_id)
SELECT w.event_id AS workshop_id, w.held_on, w.seats_sold, spend.ad_spend,
       round(spend.ad_spend / NULLIF(w.seats_sold, 0)) AS ad_spend_per_seat,
       ads.target('cost_per_seat') AS ceiling
FROM w JOIN spend USING (event_id) CROSS JOIN p
WHERE w.held_on BETWEEN p.s AND (date_trunc('month', p.e) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date
ORDER BY w.held_on

cards.name: 11 · Days unpaid
cards.sql:
-- KPI 11: Days unpaid
-- Definition : How long each open invoice has waited.
-- Formula    : Today − invoice issue date
-- Source     : Razorpay invoices
-- Target     : Amber 5–9 days, red 10+ days
-- Access     : full_access

SELECT invoice_id, lead_id, plan, amount, issued_on,
       ops.as_of() - issued_on AS days_unpaid,
       CASE WHEN ops.as_of() - issued_on >= ops.setting('invoice_red')   THEN 'Red'
            WHEN ops.as_of() - issued_on >= ops.setting('invoice_amber') THEN 'Amber' END AS colour
FROM revenue.invoices
WHERE paid_on IS NULL AND issued_on <= ops.as_of()
ORDER BY days_unpaid DESC

cards.name: 17 · Trials ending in 30 days
cards.sql:
-- KPI 17: Trials ending in 30 days
-- Definition : Trials still running that end within 30 days. Not period-based.
-- Formula    : Trial end date − today, for trials in the Trial state, where ≤ 30
-- Source     : students.enrolments
-- Target     : Yellow 16–30, amber 8–15, red ≤ 7 days left
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

SELECT e.student_id, f.lead_id, e.ends_on,
       e.ends_on - ops.as_of() AS days_left,
       CASE WHEN e.ends_on - ops.as_of() <= ops.setting('renewal_red')   THEN 'Red'
            WHEN e.ends_on - ops.as_of() <= ops.setting('renewal_amber') THEN 'Amber'
            ELSE 'Yellow' END AS colour
FROM students.enrolments e
JOIN students.students s USING (student_id)
JOIN students.families f USING (family_id)
WHERE e.status = 'In trial' AND e.ends_on - ops.as_of() <= ops.setting('renewal_yellow')
ORDER BY days_left

cards.name: 23 · Share lost between steps
cards.sql:
-- KPI 23: Share lost between steps
-- Definition : How many families each step loses (both paths).
-- Formula    : 1 − (count at step ÷ count at the step before)
-- Source     : ClickUp + enrolments
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
c AS (SELECT l.* FROM leads.v_lead_state l, p WHERE l.created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e),
steps(n, step, families) AS (
    SELECT 1, 'Came in', COUNT(*) FROM c UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Qualified or in nurture', COUNT(qualified_on) FROM c UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Ambition interview', COUNT(interview_on) FROM c UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Architect session (Leadership)', COUNT(architect_on) FROM c UNION ALL
    SELECT 5, 'Paid (trial or full)', COUNT(first_paid_on) FROM c UNION ALL
    SELECT 6, 'Converted: full term paid', COUNT(converted_on) FROM c)
SELECT step, families,
       round(100 * (1 - families::numeric / NULLIF(LAG(families) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0))) AS lost_pct
FROM steps ORDER BY n

cards.name: 22 · Funnel step count
cards.sql:
-- KPI 22: Funnel step count
-- Definition : Families from the period's intake who reached each step, by entry path.
-- Formula    : COUNT(leads in intake) where the step's date is filled
-- Source     : ClickUp stage dates + enrolments
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
paths AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['All', 'Ads', 'Workshop']) AS path)
SELECT paths.path,
       COUNT(l.lead_id)          AS came_in,
       COUNT(l.qualified_on)     AS qualified_or_nurture,
       COUNT(l.call_booked_on)   AS call_booked,
       COUNT(l.call_attended_on) AS call_held,
       COUNT(l.interview_on)     AS ambition_interview,
       COUNT(l.architect_on)     AS architect_session,
       COUNT(l.first_paid_on)    AS paid_trial_or_full,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.first_plan = 'Trial') AS of_which_trial,
       COUNT(l.converted_on)     AS converted
FROM paths CROSS JOIN p
LEFT JOIN leads.v_lead_state l ON (paths.path = 'All' OR l.entry_path = paths.path) AND l.created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY paths.path ORDER BY paths.path

cards.name: 21 · Leads / families who came in
cards.sql:
-- KPI 21: Leads / families who came in
-- Definition : Website form leads plus workshop attendees in the period, by entry path.
-- Formula    : COUNT(leads) where created date in period, by entry path
-- Source     : n8n lead webhook → ClickUp; workshop attendance
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT entry_path,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e)                               AS this_period,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_on BETWEEN ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e) AND p.s - 1)      AS period_before
FROM leads.leads, p
GROUP BY entry_path ORDER BY entry_path

cards.name: 25 · Ambition interview outcomes
cards.sql:
-- KPI 25: Ambition interview outcomes
-- Definition : Interview results split by who said no.
-- Formula    : COUNT by outcome: passed / rejected by Alcovia / dropped by family
-- Source     : ClickUp stage + reason
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT interview_outcome, COUNT(*) AS families,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) AS share_pct
FROM leads.leads, p
WHERE created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND interview_outcome IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY interview_outcome ORDER BY families DESC

cards.name: 26 · Where families came from
cards.sql:
-- KPI 26: Where families came from
-- Definition : Intake split by source. Organic = form lead with no paid campaign tag.
-- Formula    : COUNT(leads) by source: Meta ads / organic form / workshop
-- Source     : ClickUp source + campaign tags
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT CASE source WHEN 'Paid' THEN 'Meta ads' WHEN 'Organic' THEN 'Organic (form, no ad)' ELSE 'Workshops' END AS source,
       COUNT(*) AS families,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) AS share_pct
FROM leads.leads, p
WHERE created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY families DESC

cards.name: 24 · Discovery call show-up rate
cards.sql:
-- KPI 24: Discovery call show-up rate
-- Definition : Booked discovery calls that were attended (ads path).
-- Formula    : Calls attended ÷ calls booked
-- Source     : ClickUp + Smallest.ai
-- Target     : Proposal: 80%+
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT COUNT(call_booked_on) AS booked, COUNT(call_attended_on) AS attended,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(call_attended_on) / NULLIF(COUNT(call_booked_on), 0)) AS show_up_pct
FROM leads.leads, p
WHERE created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e

cards.name: 19 · Program conversion %
cards.sql:
-- KPI 19: Program conversion %
-- Definition : Share of families who came in during the period and converted.
-- Formula    : Converted ÷ families who came in during the period
-- Source     : ClickUp + enrolments
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
paths AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['All', 'Ads', 'Workshop']) AS path)
SELECT paths.path, COUNT(l.lead_id) AS came_in, COUNT(l.converted_on) AS converted,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = 'Trial') AS still_in_trial,
       round(100.0 * COUNT(l.converted_on) / NULLIF(COUNT(l.lead_id), 0), 1) AS conversion_pct
FROM paths CROSS JOIN p
LEFT JOIN leads.v_lead_state l ON (paths.path = 'All' OR l.entry_path = paths.path) AND l.created_on BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY paths.path ORDER BY paths.path

cards.name: 28 · Open leads ageing trend
cards.sql:
-- KPI 28: Open leads ageing trend
-- Definition : Each week, how many open leads were older than the target, by age band.
-- Formula    : For each week end W: COUNT(leads created ≤ W, not paid by W, not closed by W, W − created > 45), split 46–60 / 61–90 / 90+
-- Source     : ClickUp + enrolments
-- Target     : Falling to 0
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e),
weeks AS (
    SELECT w::date AS week, LEAST(w::date + 6, ops.as_of()) AS week_end
    FROM p, generate_series(date_trunc('week', p.s), p.e, interval '7 days') AS w
)
SELECT weeks.week, weeks.week_end,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age BETWEEN ops.setting('days_to_decide') + 1 AND 60) AS days_46_60,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age BETWEEN 61 AND 90)                                 AS days_61_90,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age > 90)                                              AS over_90_days,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age > ops.setting('days_to_decide'))                   AS total
FROM weeks
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT weeks.week_end - l.created_on AS age
    FROM leads.v_lead_state l
    WHERE l.created_on <= weeks.week_end
      AND (l.first_paid_on IS NULL OR l.first_paid_on > weeks.week_end)
      AND (l.closed_on IS NULL OR l.closed_on > weeks.week_end)
) open_leads ON true
GROUP BY weeks.week, weeks.week_end
ORDER BY weeks.week

cards.name: 27 · Open leads past target
cards.sql:
-- KPI 27: Open leads past target
-- Definition : Leads still in play today that came in more than 45 days ago. Not period-based.
-- Formula    : COUNT(leads) where not paid, not closed, today − created > 45
-- Source     : ClickUp + enrolments
-- Target     : 0
-- Access     : full_access, team_access

SELECT lead_id,
       CASE entry_path WHEN 'Ads' THEN 'Ads and website form' ELSE 'Workshop' END AS came_from,
       CASE WHEN architect_on     IS NOT NULL THEN 'Architect session'
            WHEN interview_on     IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ambition interview'
            WHEN call_attended_on IS NOT NULL THEN 'Discovery call held'
            WHEN call_booked_on   IS NOT NULL THEN 'Discovery call booked'
            WHEN qualified_on     IS NOT NULL THEN 'Qualified or in nurture'
            ELSE 'New lead' END                                                   AS furthest_step,
       COALESCE(architect_on, interview_on, call_attended_on, call_booked_on, qualified_on, created_on) AS last_step_on,
       ops.as_of() - created_on                                                   AS days_open
FROM leads.v_lead_state
WHERE first_paid_on IS NULL AND closed_on IS NULL
  AND ops.as_of() - created_on > ops.setting('days_to_decide')
ORDER BY days_open DESC

cards.name: 31 · Click rate (CTR)
cards.sql:
-- KPI 31: Click rate (CTR)
-- Definition : How often people who saw an ad clicked it, best to worst.
-- Formula    : Clicks ÷ impressions
-- Source     : Meta Ads
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT ad, campaign, type, impressions, clicks, ctr_pct
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
ORDER BY ctr_pct DESC

cards.name: 34 · Cost per result
cards.sql:
-- KPI 34: Cost per result
-- Definition : Spend per qualified lead (program) or per seat (workshop), per ad and per campaign.
-- Formula    : Spend ÷ results
-- Source     : Meta Ads + ClickUp / Razorpay
-- Target     : ₹5,000 per lead; ₹800 per seat
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT campaign, ad, spend, results, cost_per_result, ceiling,
       round(SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign) / NULLIF(SUM(results) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign), 0)) AS campaign_cost_per_result
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
ORDER BY campaign, cost_per_result

cards.name: 30 · Spend
cards.sql:
-- KPI 30: Spend
-- Definition : Meta ad spend in the period, per campaign and per ad.
-- Formula    : SUM(spend) in period, per ad or campaign
-- Source     : Meta Ads
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT campaign, ad, spend, SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign) AS campaign_spend
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
ORDER BY campaign_spend DESC, spend DESC

cards.name: 32 · Frequency
cards.sql:
-- KPI 32: Frequency
-- Definition : Average times each person has seen the ad (latest in the period); campaign = highest of its ads.
-- Formula    : Impressions ÷ reach as Meta reports it
-- Source     : Meta Ads
-- Target     : Below 3
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT campaign, ad, frequency,
       MAX(frequency) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign) AS campaign_frequency,
       frequency >= ads.target('frequency')        AS needs_refresh
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
ORDER BY frequency DESC

cards.name: 33 · Results
cards.sql:
-- KPI 33: Results
-- Definition : What each ad is for: qualified leads (program) or seats sold (workshop).
-- Formula    : Program: paid-ad leads qualified in period · workshop: seat payments in period, per ad
-- Source     : ClickUp / Razorpay, matched on campaign tags
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT campaign, ad, type, leads, results,
       CASE type WHEN 'Program' THEN 'qualified leads' ELSE 'seats sold' END AS result_is
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
ORDER BY campaign, results DESC

cards.name: 41 · Landing-page drop-off
cards.sql:
-- KPI 41: Landing-page drop-off
-- Definition : Visitors who left without filling a form or booking, with the period before.
-- Formula    : Visitors who left without acting ÷ visitors
-- Source     : Google Analytics 4 + Microsoft Clarity
-- Target     : Falling vs period before
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT page,
       SUM(visitors) FILTER (WHERE day BETWEEN p.s AND p.e) AS visitors,
       round(100.0 * SUM(dropoffs) FILTER (WHERE day BETWEEN p.s AND p.e) / SUM(visitors) FILTER (WHERE day BETWEEN p.s AND p.e), 1) AS dropoff_pct,
       round(100.0 * SUM(dropoffs) FILTER (WHERE day < p.s) / NULLIF(SUM(visitors) FILTER (WHERE day < p.s), 0), 1)               AS dropoff_pct_before
FROM ads.page_daily, p
WHERE day BETWEEN ops.prev_start(p.s, p.e) AND p.e
GROUP BY page ORDER BY visitors DESC

cards.name: 42 · Load time
cards.sql:
-- KPI 42: Load time
-- Definition : How fast each landing page loads, mobile and desktop.
-- Formula    : AVERAGE(daily page-speed check)
-- Source     : Google PageSpeed Insights
-- Target     : Mobile 3 s or less
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT page,
       round(AVG(load_mobile_s), 2)  AS mobile_load_s,
       round(AVG(load_desktop_s), 2) AS desktop_load_s,
       AVG(load_mobile_s) > 3        AS mobile_over_3s
FROM ads.page_daily, p
WHERE day BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
GROUP BY page ORDER BY page

cards.name: 35 · Scale
cards.sql:
-- KPI 35: Scale
-- Definition : Ads bringing results under their ceiling: spend more.
-- Formula    : See the rule in 00_helpers.sql (ads.period_ads)
-- Source     : Derived
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT ad, campaign, spend, frequency, results, cost_per_result, reason
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
WHERE action = 'Scale'
ORDER BY spend DESC

cards.name: 36 · Refresh
cards.sql:
-- KPI 36: Refresh
-- Definition : Ads whose audience has seen them 3 or more times: new creative, same audience.
-- Formula    : See the rule in 00_helpers.sql (ads.period_ads)
-- Source     : Derived
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT ad, campaign, spend, frequency, results, cost_per_result, reason
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
WHERE action = 'Refresh'
ORDER BY spend DESC

cards.name: 37 · Drop
cards.sql:
-- KPI 37: Drop
-- Definition : Ads too expensive for 2 weeks running, or bringing leads and no good fits: switch off.
-- Formula    : See the rule in 00_helpers.sql (ads.period_ads)
-- Source     : Derived
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT ad, campaign, spend, frequency, results, cost_per_result, reason
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
WHERE action = 'Drop'
ORDER BY spend DESC

cards.name: 38 · Watch
cards.sql:
-- KPI 38: Watch
-- Definition : Ads over the ceiling, but for less than 2 weeks.
-- Formula    : See the rule in 00_helpers.sql (ads.period_ads)
-- Source     : Derived
-- Target     : —
-- Access     : full_access

WITH p AS (SELECT {{start_on}}::date AS s, {{end_on}}::date AS e)
SELECT ad, campaign, spend, frequency, results, cost_per_result, reason
FROM p, ads.period_ads(p.s, p.e)
WHERE action = 'Watch'
ORDER BY spend DESC
